name: Andrew Bishop
bio: Andrew leads the newsroom from Cleveland. His career spans more than fifteen years in editorial leadership at regional daily newspapers, with a background that includes reporting on city government, state politics, and federal courts before he moved into editing. He sets the standards for what runs on the site, oversees the corrections record, and is the final authority on questions of what Classic Reporters will and will not publish.

seo.metaDescription: Articles and editorial work by Andrew Bishop, Editor-in-Chief of Classic Reporters.
